project.name: oxiguitar-musescore
project.description: MuseScore file format support for OxiGuitar — a free, open-source guitar tablature and score viewer, editor and player for Windows, macOS and Linux.

nodes.name: CI Workflow
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs formatting (rustfmt), linting (clippy), multi-platform testing, license/advisory checks (cargo-deny), and DCO sign-off validation. Uses a ci-success gate job to ensure all checks pass before merging.

nodes.name: Claude Working Guidelines
nodes.summary: Standing rules and project conventions for working on oxiguitar-musescore with Claude. Covers branch strategy, Rust versioning, PR workflow, test requirements, and repository-specific policies.

nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines for oxiguitar-musescore. Covers the GPL-3.0-or-later license terms and how to submit contributions.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Project overview for oxiguitar-musescore, a MuseScore file format support library for the OxiGuitar tablature viewer, editor, and player. Links to the main OxiGuitar repository.

nodes.summary: Shell script that checks for Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) sign-offs across a range of commits. Used in CI to verify that all commits in a PR are properly signed off.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand that oxiguitar-musescore provides MuseScore file format support for the OxiGuitar tablature viewer, editor, and player. This repository is part of the larger OxiGuitar project.

tour.title: Project Conventions
tour.description: Read CLAUDE.md for standing rules and conventions used when working on this project, including branch strategy, Rust versioning, and PR workflow.

tour.title: Contributing
tour.description: Review CONTRIBUTING.md for contribution guidelines under the GPL-3.0-or-later license.

tour.title: Rust Tooling Configuration
tour.description: Examine the Rust tooling configs: clippy.toml for lint rules, deny.toml for license and advisory compliance, and rustfmt.toml for code formatting.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipeline
tour.description: Review the GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs formatting, linting, multi-platform testing, license checks, and DCO sign-off validation. The ci-success gate job ensures all checks pass before merging.
